- Align on capacity profile (average tokens / peak sustained)
- Confirm pricing and term options for the 24-month path
- Schedule a QBR/technical handoff so CS can scope onboarding for additional GPUs

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal review and a single-track MA plan draft — I’ve attached a first-pass (Lumina_MAPlan_v1.pdf).
2) Quick procurement checklist you can share with Finance (I’ll send separately if useful).
3) QBR — please pick from these windows: Nov 29 10–11am PT, Dec 2 2–3pm PT, or Dec 7 9–10am PT. I attached an .ics poll to make it easy.

Can you confirm: (a) which QBR slot works, (b) who from your side needs to attend (procurement, platform engineering, security), and (c) any hard constraints for the go-live?

I’ve looped in Karthik (renewals) and Ben (pricing lead) so we can move quickly.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
